description: For a business owner asking "is my business visible to ChatGPT / AI?": returns the business's public AI Boost score (0-100 and N of 10, from facts anyone can check, each part dated), what each fix is worth in points, how it compares with claimed shops in its town, its score history, and whether ChatGPT and Claude named it in its last saved AssistAnt AI check. Use find_pro_by_name first to get the slug. The score measures visibility to AI assistants, not the quality of the work.

slug.description: Listing slug from find_pro_by_name or find_pros

name: check_ai_visibility
title: Check how visible a business is to AI assistants
